title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.15
subtitle: Less capture work and faster animation encoding.

highlights.title: One motion sample by default
highlights.description: New and reset Collider settings capture one sample per Blender frame, matching the poses used by the current solver. Existing saved sample counts are retained.

highlights.title: Compact animation encoding
highlights.description: Long Collider animations stay in compact numeric arrays during solver preparation, avoiding millions of Python objects and preserving exact wire bytes.
